doxygen-awesome-css v2.4.2
https://github.com/jothepro/doxygen-awesome-css
MIT, see LICENSE beside this file.

Vendored rather than fetched at build time so the docs build is reproducible and
works with no network, exactly like vendor/mermaid.min.js. Upgrade by replacing
these files from a tagged release and re-running `doxygen Doxyfile`.
